name: Bunny Ghost
source:
Bunny Ghost is the ghost that students of New Sriwijaya 70 High School gossip about. They say that if you make a contract with her, you will be cursed with bad luck and die a tragic death. It is this tragic fate itself that the students fear the most. Because of these rumors, they make sure never to visit the school at night or stay late on campus.

However, this character is actually neither a ghost nor a human being. The ghost title was given by the students thinking Citra and her to be the same person. She is something you would never expect. To find out the truth, would you be willing to sign a contract with her to learn more?
